_meta.source: MOE PSLE scoring and S1 posting pages; MOE Full SBB FAQ; MOE curriculum page on Higher Mother Tongue; MOE SchoolFinder (Beatty Secondary)
_meta.units: PSLE Achievement Levels (AL 1 best to AL 8), PSLE Score 4 to 32
_meta.notes: Read from search engine extracts of the primary MOE pages on 2026-10-27; the pages themselves could not be opened end to end from the research session. Eyeball once against moe.gov.sg before a class uses this. Everything a student enters here is hypothetical and stays on the device.

postingGroups.note: Choose one group before listing schools. It applies to all six choices.
Choose one group before listing schools. It applies to all six choices.

postingGroups.needs: AL 7 or better in both English and Mathematics

noGroup: This score does not map to a Posting Group. That is a conversation with the primary school about the routes that exist, including specialised schools and repeating P6. It is not the end of a road.

rules.text: AL 5 or better at Standard: can start this subject at G3.
AL 6 at Standard, or A at Foundation: can start this subject at G2.

upgrades.note: Schools offer these, and families decide. Starting higher is a choice, not an instruction, and it does not fix the level for Sec 3: every level is reviewed with everyone else.

rules.text: Taken at Foundation: the school can offer this subject at G2.
Foundation A: the school can offer Mother Tongue at G2.
Foundation B or C: the school can offer Mother Tongue at G2 or G1.

downgrades.note: Posting Group 3 with a Foundation subject: a less demanding start in that subject is an option, decided with the school.

hmtl.text: Higher Mother Tongue in Sec 1 is open to AL 1 or 2 in Mother Tongue, or Distinction or Merit in Higher Mother Tongue, whatever the overall score (2026 Sec 1 intake onwards). Schools can offer it to others too.

school.name: Beatty Secondary
school.note: The score of the last student admitted in the 2025 posting, from MOE SchoolFinder. Ranges move every year and are not a promise either way.
